messages:
michelle_ops: quick heads-up — flexLogix updated: 24-unit EU top-off shipment hit FRA customs. 4 units reported DOA on arrival inspection. vendor proposes 2 air replacements + repair for 2, or full RMA return. they quoted expedited handling + brokerage ~€13.8k. need decision on cost routing
raj_procurement: do we have the original PO and committed allocation for this wave? who paid shipping originally?
michelle_ops: PO# PO-48722 was committed as reserved capacity for eu-edge. shipping was vendor prepaid DAP. vendor says insurance covers 50% of DOA value but only if we file claim + RMA within 5 days.
linus_logistics: depot capacity ok for 24 units but not for staging a long RMA return pile. if we accept air replacements, we'll need AWB and expedited customs docs. ETA for air ~48h after vendor handoff.
sara_finance: can we get vendor to absorb expedite? €13.8k non-trivial vs lost revenue from unavailable GPUs. what's per-unit list / replacement pricing?\michael_ops: michelle_ops here — vendor ratecard: unit replacement Sku H200-est price €21k ea. DOA value for 4u ~€84k; vendor says insurance + credit note will cover ~50% (~€42k). they want us to accept repair + small expedite fee or we take replacements + pay brokerage if we insist.
ana_infra: (ana_infra) 4 units out of 24 reduces our EU buffer by ~17%. If we don't top-off immediately we risk saturating queues on high-prio tenants next week. Can we hot-swap capacity from us-west spare pool for 72h? cross-region latency ok for some non-latency-critical workloads.
raj_procurement: propose 2 options: 1) push vendor to cover full expedite + insurance claim (ask flexLogix to pick up air cost), 2) accept repair flow + vendor credit and request temporary loaners (vendor or rental) for EU pool. preference #1 if vendor agrees.
linus_logistics: operational constraints: if vendor pays, we can accept air. else Sea-return RMA will take ~14 days + customs cycles. Need to confirm AWB and RMA ID to start customs docs.
michelle_ops: opening RMA ticket and insurance claim now, pinged vendor contact Emma. Draft RMA note:
```
RMA-84721: 4x DOA H200 units
AWB (hold): EUR-FF123456789
Vendor contact: Emma / FlexLogix
Claim window: 5 days from receipt
Requested action: expedited replacements OR repair + credit
```
shipbot: IncidentBot: RMA ticket RMA-84721 created and linked to PO-48722. SLA: vendor response 72h.
sara_finance: quick calc — if vendor covers full expedite (€13.8k) we take replacements and file insurance for repair value; net outflow 0. if vendor refuses, expedite cost + taxes could be charged to our ops budget, or we renegotiate replacement discount. I'll pre-approve up to €8k from contingency, beyond that needs finance sign-off.
nana_infra: if we do cross-region loaners, list of candidates: west-pool-01 (8 GPUs), west-pool-02 (6 GPUs). switching will trigger rebalancing and ephemeral quota changes. ops impact minimal if only for 72h.
raj_procurement: michelle — ask Emma specifically: will FlexLogix cover expedite + brokerage if DOA count >=3? cc: contract clause 6.2 (warranty/replacement). push for vendor RMA return label + courier pickup to avoid customs charges.
michelle_ops: on it. pinged Emma: "Can FlexLogix confirm covering expedite + brokerage if DOA >=3? If not, provide best-case air cost breakdown and earliest handoff ETA."
emma_vendor (via michelle_ops): "Emma (FlexLogix) here — we can cover courier if DOA confirmed and photos + initial inspection docs provided. We need RMA acceptance before courier booking. Can you share depot pickup window?"
linus_logistics: depot pickup OK Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 CET. provide pallet label and customs invoice.
michelle_ops: shared docs and inspection photos. vendor acknowledged. they asked we sign off on repairs for 2 units to be returned for parts; replacements for 2 via air.
sara_finance: condition: vendor covers courier + brokerage only. we cover any customs duty differential if classification changes. finance holds back €4k contingency to cover paperwork surprises.
raj_procurement: sounds acceptable. michelle — confirm vendor will issue written credit note for repaired units (expected credit value >= €21k each?) and confirm timeline for replacement AWBs.
michelle_ops: vendor to send written credit note and AWBs within 24h. if not received by EOD tomorrow, escalate to vendor ops head. I'll update RMA ticket with AWBs when received.
nana_infra: plan B if vendor stalls: approve cross-region loaners + open rental quotes for 4 GPUs (48h turnaround). prefer not to rent if vendor moves.
michelle_ops: TL;DR actions: 1) Vendor to confirm courier + brokerage coverage (asked) 2) RMA-84721 created and synced to PO-48722 3) Await vendor AWBs and credit note (24h) 4) If no confirm, trigger loaner + rental quotes.
raj_procurement: +1 to that plan. michelle pls add me to escalation thread if vendor doesn't respond.
sara_finance: i'll prep contingency release if vendor confirms partial coverage.
linus_logistics: prepping customs docs and pallet labels; will need final AWB to book pickup.
shipbot: Reminder scheduled: ping vendor if no AWB by 2765442000 (24h).
michelle_ops: thanks everyone. I'll post updates in this thread and update RMA ticket. :thumbsup:
